title: Are You Human? — One Warm Light

segments.text: They say tomorrow's town doesn't need my café. But I saved you a seat.
segments.instructions: Speak in natural English. You are Mia, a warm, gentle adult character in a tiny cafe at night. Soft sadness, intimate and sincere. No exaggerated acting. Emphasize 'you' very gently.

segments.text: In this AI town, progress has a cost. The central upgrade takes power from Mia's café.
segments.instructions: Natural English, warm clear documentary narrator. Curious, thoughtful, never a sales pitch. A measured but brisk pace.

segments.text: Tomo needs that upgrade to repair his voice. Your goal: keep both futures alive.
segments.instructions: Natural English, warm clear documentary narrator. Emphasize both futures. Measured and brisk, no long pauses.

segments.text: Look closer. The data center throws away heat. What if that warmth could save the café?
segments.instructions: Natural English, warm clear documentary narrator. A small moment of discovery. Curious, then hopeful. Brisk but intelligible.

segments.text: Propose a solution in your own words. OpenAI models interpret it. Residents choose a partner and decide how to help.
segments.instructions: Natural English, warm clear documentary narrator. Confident and specific. Flowing, brisk pacing, not a commercial.

segments.text: They walk to their jobs and work together. Their actions change the town.
segments.instructions: Natural English, warm clear documentary narrator. The delight of watching little characters work together. Conversational, not overexcited.

segments.text: The update finishes. The café stays warm. Your discovery becomes their shared tomorrow.
segments.instructions: Natural English, warm clear documentary narrator. Quiet satisfaction, warm and human. Let the last phrase land.

segments.text: Are You Human? A small town where conversation becomes cooperation.
segments.instructions: Natural English. Warm, clear, inviting. Read the title as a gentle question. Leave a brief pause before the second sentence. Avoid promotional exaggeration.
